items.title: Nexus
items.en_oneliner: Maps all your projects and their linked services on one visual graph — click any node to jump straight to it; local-first and free for up to 3 projects.

items.title: Zoom Slides
items.en_oneliner: Turns meeting discussions or a short prompt into polished, editable decks, with AI rewriting, collaboration, and PowerPoint export.

items.title: Happo animation testing
items.en_oneliner: Captures your UI animations frame by frame and diffs how they move, so a broken spinner or transition shows up before merge.

items.title: Aboard Sign
items.en_oneliner: Get any agreement signed by email — just CC one address and everyone receives a link to sign, no signup needed.
